name: Billing Services Amount 2
definition: Taxable service charge amount conversions to host currency.

HostAmount.name: Host Amount
HostAmount.definition: Sum of the original charge host amount and the service tax host amount values. It represents the total charge for a service (including taxes) expressed in the host currency.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Sum of the original charge host amount and the service tax host amount values but expressed in the settlement currency.

PricingAmount.name: Pricing Amount
PricingAmount.definition: Sum of the original charge host amount and the service tax host amount values but expressed in the pricing currency.
